name: Watch a value
description: Watches one value on the web (a price, a status, a count) as a chip and a card. A notification when it changes, or only when it goes above or below the limits you set (a price alert).

settings.label: Address of the page or API (https://…)
The value to watch (press Find values and pick it)
Tell me when it goes above (optional)
Tell me when it goes below (optional)
